messages:
sofia (Docs): Heads up — opened a PR updating SOC2 wording around audit log retention + an SDK migration snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4387
ben_k (Security): :eyes: thanks. quick Q — are we standardizing on 12 months or 24 months for audit logs?
aisha (Legal): For SOC2 it's fine to define a retention policy and justify it. Legal prefers 12 months by default; exceptions allowed with approval.
matt (Eng): If we pick 12mo, we should update the SDK examples to show `retention_days: 365` and add a migration note for clients that used `log_retention`.
sofia (Docs): Draft wording I added in the PR: "Audit logs are retained for 12 months by default. Customers can request extended retention under enterprise contracts. Sensitive fields in logs are redacted by default; see redaction section." Thoughts?
ben_k (Security): tweak: change "redacted by default" -> "redacted by default where possible, with configurable mask rules" — we can't claim blanket redaction.
aisha (Legal): Agreed. Also add a legal hold note: "Records subject to legal hold will be retained until officially released."
matt (Eng): SDK snippet suggestion (JS):
```js
// v2 SDK
await client.logs.create({
  source: 'api',
  retention_days: 365,
  redact: true
})
```
Migration notes to add: - old `log_retention` -> new `retention_days` (integer) - update examples in Python/Go
sofia (Docs): I'll patch the PR with that snippet + migration note. Also CI flagged a broken link (docs/security/redaction.md) — 404 on the internal anchor. If someone can fix the anchor or update the link text that'd help.
ci-bot: docs-preview: build succeeded — preview at https://deploy-preview-4387--docs.redwood.ai
ben_k (Security): :thumbsup: I'll add the exact redaction wording and link to the data-handling policy (internal).
aisha (Legal): I'll add the legal hold sentence and confirm 12 months is fine.
matt (Eng): I'll push the Python snippet in a follow-up commit (small diff).
sofia (Docs): Thanks all — aiming to merge by EOD. If no objections I'll merge at 5pm PST. :clock5:
ben_k (Security): No objections from security.
aisha (Legal): LGTM from Legal.
ci-bot: PR merged by sofia — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4387
